backup.title: System Backup — JSON
backup.intro: A JSON backup of your database records; Human Design chart and report images are included, photos and files from other modules are not included. This file can be imported again from the Restore tab. When the download finishes, each table is compared with the record count on the server and the result is shown below.
backup.excludedNote: Account/session details, administrator records, search indexes and shared catalogues are not backed up (they are listed with reasons in the "excluded" list in the file).

backup.failed: The backup could not be created.

backup.outcomeIncomplete: Backup INCOMPLETE: {count, plural, one {{n} table could not be read in full} other {{n} tables could not be read in full}}. The file was downloaded but is not reliable for {count, plural, one {this table} other {these tables}}.

skipReasons.unlicensed: module not active on your account

restore.introTitle: Restore does not return your account to its state on the backup date. Only missing records are added; existing records are not changed or deleted.
restore.intro1: Records that are in the backup but not currently in your account (e.g. deleted ones) are added back with their original IDs and dates.
restore.intro2: Records you changed after the backup do not revert to their backed-up state; records you added after the backup are not deleted.
restore.intro3: Restoring the same backup again does not create duplicate records; the operation can safely be run again.
restore.intro4: Human Design images are restored from the file (size and SHA-256 verified; existing files are not overwritten); photos and files from other modules are not included in the backup and are not restored.
restore.intro5: Records for modules that are not active on your account are skipped. Supported backup versions: 1.0, 2.0, 2.1, 3.0.
restore.incompleteInFile: In this backup file, {count, plural, one {{n} table was} other {{n} tables were}} marked INCOMPLETE when the backup was taken: {tables}
restore.otherAccount: This backup was taken from another account. Record IDs are kept; records that still exist in the source account are skipped as 'exists in another account'.
restore.invalidJson: The file is not a valid JSON backup (corrupted, incomplete or empty file). Choose a file created from the System Backup tab.
restore.readFailed: The file could not be read.
restore.toastComplete: Missing records were added; existing records were not changed.
restore.toastPartial: The restore was partially completed; details below.
restore.confirm: I confirm: only missing records will be added; my existing records will not be changed or deleted, and my account will not return to its state on the backup date.

archive.intro: Premium Word Archive (ZIP): a readable Word dump of your records, client files and your saved ready analysis reports in organised folders. Reports are not recalculated; they are produced as saved.
archive.intro1: The Word archive cannot be restored. To restore into your account, use the System Backup (JSON) tab.
archive.intro2: Photos and attachments are optional; they are not embedded in Word but added as separate files.
archive.intro3: If any part is missing, the archive is marked "INCOMPLETE" and the parts are listed in the ARŞİV-RAPORU.txt file.
archive.contentLanguage: Record dump Word documents inside the archive are produced in your display language. Folder and file names, BENİOKU.txt and ARŞİV-RAPORU.txt, and some saved module reports may still be produced in Turkish.
archive.searchPlaceholder: Search by first or last name
archive.clientHint: When clients are selected, only records linked to a client are archived; unlinked records (catalogue, knowledge base) are listed as out of scope.

include.dataHint: All records of the selected modules; large modules are split into parts.

include.reportsHint: Saved HD, HD Relationship, Celestial Atlas and Numerology reports.
include.filesHint: Analysis images and client stone photos, intake PDFs, Personal Archive, stone catalogue, Natural Wellness Guide, HD chart, stock and Personal Office images (separate files).
include.sensitiveHint: Intake, nutrition summary, internal notes and pricing are added to the client file.
